items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: And on drums we had Amos Woodard... I was playing alto in the middle.

ctx.x: up. But it paid off. Because six months later, I was kicking the platoons off! I was straw-bossing.

Yeah, and then after that we had some great guys... We had a great trumpet player named Edwin Davis; they called him Youngblood. And the other trumpet player was Ducky Taylor. And I mentioned Trombone Smitty on trombone before, and Lorenzo Lawson was the tenor player. We had a great drummer named Amos Woodard...
